scientific_limitations: The formula treats a complete graph with one private leaf per core vertex and uniform stationary distribution only.
Only the orbit-invariant optimum is shown unique; symmetry-breaking optima are not classified.
General prior symmetry-reduction methods leave a residual potential implication overlap; historical uniqueness is not certified.
Finite computational checks support identities but are not the infinite-family proof.
